column2: Retain accession at eight and thirty-one years in Jerusalem. Do not insert a maternal identification absent from the selected verse.
Retain upright conduct, David's ways and neither right nor left deviation. The two directions remain an explicit pair.

Retain seeking in year eight while still a boy and cleansing beginning in year twelve, with high places/groves/cast objects. Carved objects are not added to this particular list merely because verse 4 includes them.

Retain singular demolition before him, Baal altars and high places on them, groves, both carved/cast objects, pulverizing and distribution on worshipers' graves. The selected high places are not silently identified as incense stands.
column3: The singular action and before him expression remain awkward and provisional.

column2: Retain priests' bones burned on the altars and cleansing of Judah/Jerusalem. The desecration of former cult sites is not softened into removal alone.
Retain Ephraim, Manasseh, Simeon and Naphtali in the selected order and surrounding places. The unfinished location phrase continues into verse 7.
Retain demolition of groves/altars, finely broken idols, all high places throughout Israel and return to Jerusalem. No extra ruins phrase is imported from a different text.

Retain year eighteen, cleansing purpose, Shaphan/Eselias, Maasias's city office and Joah/Joahaz's recorder office, and strengthening the Lord's house. The purpose infinitive is not silently turned into an assured completed cleansing date.
Retain Hilkiah as high priest, silver, gatekeeping Levites and the complete contributor list including rulers and Jerusalem residents. No return-to-Jerusalem verb replaces the final residents.

Retain appointed temple officials delivering to workers and the repeated workers/delivery phrase for repairing and strengthening. No distinct financial office is invented beyond the expressed appointments.
Retain four-foot stones, wood for beams, roofing and buildings destroyed by Judah's kings. Do not change the selected dimension expression to an assured squared/hewn designation.
column3: Four-foot stones requires specialist lexical and construction review; it is not a verified modern measurement prescription.

column2: Retain faithful workers, four named Levite overseers under Merari/Kaath and every Levite skilled in song instruments. The clause continues to the burden-bearing oversight in verse 13.
column3: Jeth, Abdias and Mosollam, and Kohath/Kaath name consistency, remain provisional rather than normalized silently.

column2: Retain oversight of burden-bearers and all workers task by task, then Levite scribes, judges and gatekeepers. Was is supplied to complete the nominal continuation from every Levite.
column3: The attachment of the musical Levites to oversight remains a provisional contextual syntax decision.

column2: Retain discovery while bringing out collected silver, Hilkiah and a book of the Lord's law by Moses' hand. The formula does not itself establish an autograph manuscript claim.
Retain Hilkiah's report of finding a law book in the Lord's house and giving it to Shaphan. The repeated book is not removed for variation.
Retain Shaphan bringing the book and also reporting all given silver in the working servants' hands. Do not replace this financial report with a different all-assigned-work-completed statement.
Retain melting the silver and its delivery to overseers and workers. Melted is not silently changed to poured out merely to simplify the account.
Retain the separate book report, Hilkiah as priest and Shaphan reading before the king. No additional public audience is added here.
Retain hearing the law's words and tearing garments. The emotional interpretation remains in the narrated action rather than an added adjective.
Retain all five emissaries with paternal or official identifications, including Abdon son of Michaias. Do not substitute the differently named figure in Kings.
Retain inquiry for king and all remaining Israel/Judah, discovered book, burning wrath and failure to obey all written words. Against us interprets the preposition within the threat context.
column3: The preposition can more closely be in/among us; the inherited rendering remains provisional.

column2: Retain Huldah as prophetess and wife within the Sellem/Thakouath/Chelles chain, herself keeping robes, Jerusalem and Masana. The feminine keeper participle agrees with Huldah, not a masculine husband or ancestor.
column3: Masana and English name equivalents remain unresolved; no automatic second-quarter geographical identification is inserted.

column2: Retain the past Thus said, Israel's God and command to tell the man who sent them. The following oracle remains nested speech.

Restore Behold before I am bringing, since the selected oracle expressly marks the announcement. Retain evils upon this place and all words in the book read before Judah's king; do not substitute curses or add inhabitants within this verse. The close draft preserves inherited wording.
Retain abandonment, incense to foreign gods, works of hands, anger already kindled and future non-quenching. Divine Me/My contrasts with ordinary human pronouns, not Thou-address.
Retain the separate instruction concerning Judah's king and the dangling The words which you have heard opening. The continuation is left linked to verse 27 without a reconstructed causal connective.
column3: The oracle's opening accusative construction remains provisional and requires fuller syntax review.

column2: Retain heart feeling shame, twice humbling before God, hearing words about place/inhabitants, torn garments, tears and God's hearing. Shame is not silently changed to a tender-heart image.

Restore Behold before I am adding, preserving the second explicit announcement marker. Retain adding to fathers, plural your tombs, in peace, eyes not seeing all coming evils and the report back. The close draft preserves inherited wording.
column3: The relation of peaceful burial to Josiah's later violent death remains a textual/narrative question, not grounds to rewrite the promise.

column2: Retain the king sending and gathering Judah's and Jerusalem's elders. The emissaries are not newly named.
Retain ascent with all Judah, Jerusalem residents, priests, Levites and great-to-small people, and all covenant words read in their hearing. The reader is contextually the king.

Retain pillar position, covenant before the Lord, walking before Him, three command categories and whole heart/soul. The final words-of-covenant apposition remains rather than being replaced with an unexpressed perform verb.
Retain making everyone in Jerusalem/Benjamin stand and Jerusalem residents making a covenant in God's house. Do not replace their covenant-making with the wording of a different obedience formula.
column3: Whether standing implies formal pledge remains open; no extra oath language is supplied.

column2: Retain removal from all Israelite land, all Jerusalem/Israel residents serving throughout his days and final singular he not turning aside. Do not pluralize the final subject to match other textual forms.
column3: The final unnamed subject is contextually Josiah rather than grammatically named again.
